admonitions:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains `kernel 6.12.111-136.204`, which fixes a kernel panic during memory reclaim ([#2845](https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2845)) that caused nodes to unexpectedly reboot on releases [v20260930](https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/releases/tag/v20260930) and [v20261003](https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/releases/tag/v20261003).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains `kernel 6.12.110` in Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs which might cause kernel panic on certain instances for kubernetes versions 1.31 to 1.35. See [https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2845](https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2845)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains `kernel 6.12.110-135.201` in Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs which might cause kernel panic on certain instances for kubernetes versions 1.31 to 1.35. See [https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2845](https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2845)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains `ENA driver` (`2.17.0g`) in Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs which might cause kernel panic and unexpected node reboot.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This AMI release contains [memory leak patch](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/12750) for [containerd memory leak issue: containerd#12738](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues/12738).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release was abandoned in favor of the newer `v20260129` release.
> `v20260129` has all of this `v20260128`'s changes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> `v20251209` is the final EKS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 (AL2) AMI release. Please see #2545 for more information.

> [!WARNING]
> The Amazon Linux 2023-based AMIs in this release may experience delays with network connectivity if booted/rebooted with multiple network interfaces. This includes interfaces attached dynamically by the VPC CNI or other actors.

> [!WARNING]
> Amazon Linux 2 GPU AMIs on Kubernetes version 1.32 have started installing NVIDIA drivers via the runfile method.
> Dependencies on previously existing packages/libraries may cause issues.

> [!WARNING]
> Amazon Linux package repositories now offer `containerd` 2.0. EKS AMIs do not yet utilize `containerd` 2.0 by default.
> However, if you update packages on your nodes (e.g. `yum update`), `containerd` 2.0 will now be installed, and you may encounter compatibility issues. Please see #2308 for more information.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains an incorrect version of `nvidia-container-toolkit` (`v1.16.1`) in Amazon Linux 2 GPU AMIs.
> In some cases, this may cause failures in your containers. See https://github.com/awslabs/amazon-eks-ami/issues/2165 for an example.
